moon.blood_moon: Blood Moon rises - the dead evolve as the night deepens, and nobody sleeps
moon.blue_moon: Blue Moon rises - players gain Luck until dawn
moon.yellow_moon: Yellow Moon rises - crops grow faster until dawn
moon.super_blood: SUPER BLOOD MOON - a four-wave horde and a sleepless night
moon.super_blue: SUPER BLUE MOON - Luck II blankets the land until dawn
moon.super_yellow: SUPER YELLOW MOON - crops surge, and something falls from the sky?
moon.hexalunar_calamity.no_sleep: You cannot sleep during a Blood Moon
moon.hexalunar_calamity.horde_incoming: The horde closes in: four waves are gathering
moon.hexalunar_calamity.horde_cleared: Dawn breaks; the horde scatters - a few of the dead still wander
command.hexalunar_calamity.moon.cleared: Moon phase cleared: no moon tonight
command.hexalunar_calamity.horde.started: Horde started: four waves are gathering
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.ammo_box_hint: Right-click to store matching ammo; reloading draws from it first
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.creative_box: Works from anywhere in your inventory (backpack / hotbar / off hand): infinite ammo for every weapon, no need to hold it or switch types
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.crossbow_cont: RMB to cock/load (draws the string, puts a bolt on the rail) · RMB again to aim through the 4x scope · LMB to shoot · after firing you must cock it again yourself
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.akm_controls: Hold RMB to aim · LMB full-auto fire · R to reload (auto when empty)
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.sight_mount: Sneak + RMB: take the optic off · hold an optic in the off hand and sneak + RMB to mount it on the top rail
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.bow_controls: Hold right-click to aim & charge · left-click fires at current draw
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.range_hint: Effective range: %s blocks; shots drop sharply beyond it
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_frag: Hold RMB 1s to pull the pin (letting go mid-pull puts it back) - AFTER the pin is out you must KEEP holding: release and the striker fires, 5s fuse burns down in your hand - LMB to throw (it arcs) - Sneak + RMB 1s re-inserts the pin (only while the spoon is still held) - fragments wound everything nearby
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_flash: Hold RMB 1s to pull the pin (letting go mid-pull puts it back) - AFTER the pin is out you must KEEP holding: release and the striker fires, 5s fuse burns down in your hand - LMB to throw (it arcs) - Sneak + RMB 1s re-inserts the pin (only while the spoon is still held) - blast of light and noise stuns and blinds
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_safe: Safety pin: in, spoon pressed by your hand - completely safe
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_pulli: Pulling the pin... let go and it slides back in
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_reins: Re-inserting the pin... let go and it starts over
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_prime: Pin out, spoon held by your hand - fuse not lit yet, but the instant you let go the striker fires: 5s fuse, then it goes off in your hand
tooltip.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_armed: Fuse burning: %ss left - throw it now or it goes off in your hand
hud.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_safe: Hold RMB to pull the pin (1s)
hud.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_armed: FUSE BURNING %ss - LMB throw / R emergency throw!
hud.hexalunar_calamity.grenade_primed: Pin out - hand pressing the spoon (release or switch weapon = lit) - LMB throw / R emergency / Sneak + RMB re-insert
message.hexalunar_calamity.pin_pulled: Pin out - your hand still presses the spoon (fuse not lit), but the moment you let go the striker fires; to back out: Sneak + RMB to re-insert
message.hexalunar_calamity.pin_reinsert_: To re-insert the pin: hold Shift (sneak) and press RMB for 1s
message.hexalunar_calamity.need_cock: Crossbow is not cocked: RMB (or R) to cock/load it
message.hexalunar_calamity.crossbow_unco: Crossbow left your hand: string released, bolt returned to inventory
message.hexalunar_calamity.pin_slipped: You let go mid-pull, the pin slid back in
message.hexalunar_calamity.fuse_lit: Spoon released - striker fired, fuse lit (5s). Throw it!
message.hexalunar_calamity.fuse_no_pin_b: The fuse is lit - too late to re-insert the pin. Press R to throw it!
message.hexalunar_calamity.grip_lost_fus: Grenade slipped out of your grip (weapon switched / stowed) - spoon released, striker fired, fuse lit! Press R to throw it
message.hexalunar_calamity.need_pin: Pull the pin first: hold RMB for a second
message.hexalunar_calamity.creative_box_: The creative ammo box works from anywhere in your inventory: infinite ammo for every weapon
